summary: Air to Drive landing page + Stripe-unconfigured checkout iteration tested end-to-end. Backend: 10/10 pytest cases green — /api/checkout/config returns {enabled:false, product:'Lifetime Access', amount_display:'$19.95', currency:'USD'}; /api/checkout/session returns 503 with 'Stripe is not configured yet. Add STRIPE_SECRET_KEY to backend/.env.'; /api/checkout/status rejects non cs_-prefixed id with 400 and returns 503 for cs_test_abc; /api/stripe/webhook returns 503 without secret; existing endpoints (/api/, /api/samples, /api/sample-file/transfer-report.txt, /api/sample-file/telemetry.json 120 samples, POST+GET /api/status with persistence) still fully functional. Frontend web homepage renders the PWA landing page: nav (logo + Install App + Get Lifetime), headline 'Massive Files Directly to External Drives, Zero Phone Storage Required', subheadline with 'twelve-hour creator videos' copy, three feature callouts (feature-video / feature-pro / feature-astro) with correct Video Creators / Mobile Professionals / Amateur Astronomers copy, pricing card (pricing-card) showing $19.95 one-time + all 5 bullets + buy-button + helper line 'Checkout activates once Stripe keys are added'. Install prompt (install-prompt) auto-opens ~0.9s after load with install-accept + install-dismiss; clicking install-dismiss hides it and the dismissal persists across a hard reload (AsyncStorage flag). Clicking buy-button triggers POST /api/checkout/session which returns 503; UI stays on '/' (no crash, no redirect) and surfaces an info toast 'Checkout isn't live yet — add your Stripe key to enable purchases.' /success without session_id shows 'Something went wrong — Missing checkout session.' and the success-home button returns to '/' and the landing page renders. /success?session_id=cs_test_bad shows 'Unable to verify payment.' error state (backend 503). No React Native red screen, no deprecated expo packages. Only pre-existing console warnings observed: 'shadow* style props are deprecated' and 'props.pointerEvents is deprecated' (both from dependencies, unchanged from iteration_1).

react_native_issues.issue: Console warning '"shadow*" style props are deprecated. Use "boxShadow"' logged on web — originates from React Native Web / libraries. Not blocking. Reference: /app/frontend/src/landing/LandingPage.tsx:280 (btnPrimary uses shadowColor/shadowOpacity/shadowRadius/shadowOffset which map to deprecated web shadow props).
Pre-existing console warning 'props.pointerEvents is deprecated. Use style.pointerEvents' still logged (from upstream dependency, unchanged from iteration_1).

action_items: (Optional) Migrate shadowColor/shadowOpacity/shadowRadius/shadowOffset in LandingPage.tsx (btnPrimary, pricingCard, installCard) to the new 'boxShadow' style prop on web to silence the deprecation warning — RN 0.76+ supports a cross-platform boxShadow shorthand.

(Optional) After Stripe keys are added (STRIPE_SECRET_KEY and STRIPE_WEBHOOK_SECRET), re-run tests expecting /api/checkout/session → 200 with checkout_url+session_id, /api/checkout/status with real cs_ id → paid/pending data, and /api/stripe/webhook signature verification.
No code fix required for this iteration — Stripe-unconfigured UX is working exactly as specified.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py cleanly gates Stripe with _stripe_key()/_stripe_ready(); 503 responses are correct and detail messages are user-friendly.
Checkout session row is upserted into db.orders with 'pending' status before Stripe call succeeds — fine; _record_session later flips order_status to 'paid'.
/api/checkout/status correctly validates session_id prefix before calling Stripe (prevents wasted API calls on garbage input).

LandingPage.tsx uses testID on every interactive element (nav-install, nav-buy, hero-buy, hero-install, buy-button, install-prompt, install-accept, install-dismiss, pricing-card, feature-*) — excellent testability.
usePwaInstall.ts persists dismissal via storage util — verified to survive reload.
useCheckout.ts correctly treats 503 as a soft-fail path (shows toast) instead of throwing — no console errors besides the expected 503 network log.
server.py still uses deprecated @app.on_event('shutdown') — carried over from iteration_1, non-blocking.
seed_data_creation: One StatusCheck row created with client_name='TEST_landing_checkout_suite' during pytest run; harmless. No Stripe orders created (unconfigured).
context_for_next_testing_agent: When Stripe keys are added later: set STRIPE_SECRET_KEY (sk_...) and STRIPE_PRICE_ID (optional, price_...) in backend/.env, restart backend, then /api/checkout/config should return enabled:true, /api/checkout/session should return 200 with checkout_url+session_id, and the frontend buy-button should window.location.assign() to Stripe. Add STRIPE_WEBHOOK_SECRET for /api/stripe/webhook to accept signed events. Base URL for tests: EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL (loaded from /app/frontend/.env in test_landing_checkout.py).
rca_of_issue: N/A — all specified behavior reproduced successfully. The 503 responses and info-toast UX are intentional per the problem statement until Stripe keys are supplied.
